prompt: User constraint update for this ongoing review: treat this as research-experiment / rapid-exploration mode, not production-code audit. Only P0/P1 issues that concretely make the current experiment result wrong, significantly distorted, break the core variable/control relation, introduce serious leakage/metric/logic error, or make the present conclusion uninterpretable may block. P2 items (style, maintainability, production safety, unused extreme cases, engineering elegance, unrelated baselines/ablations/statistics) are non-blocking and should be brief or omitted. Report at most 3 P0/P1 issues. For every P0/P1, explicitly state how it would change this experiment's result or conclusion; if no concrete impact can be stated, do not classify it as blocking. Do not expand scope or request reruns merely for completeness. If there is no clear P0/P1, conclude the experiment can continue within its frozen narrow claim ceiling. Preserve the integrity checks and accepted-result contract, but apply this prioritization.
